summary: Provides core orchestration for Python source code analysis, including project and workspace initialization, module and file context loading, cache management, and metadata registration.
responsibilities: Initialize project and workspace contexts for Python analysis.,Load modules and files for analysis.,Manage module cache and metadata creation.,Resolve source roots and package configurations.
relationships: Project initialization uses workspace configuration and source root resolution to set up analysis contexts.
design_decisions: Modular organization of analysis steps including initialization, workspace resolution, module loading, cache deletion, and metadata handling.
